VERDICT: FAIL

The evidence does not actually demonstrate that the rounding-drift bug was fixed. The CI log shows 23 tests pass and package.json shows no dependency changes (satisfying criterion 2), but there is no code diff, no new or updated test that specifically reproduces and covers the rounding/netting drift, and no before/after demonstration. Passing the pre-existing 23 tests doesn't prove the specific bug is resolved—criterion 1 is unverified.
